beats.care: Fuel prices are global, so this matters for India too. India has its own plan to protect energy sites and Black Sea shipping.
beats.what: On Sunday, Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to stop attacking each other's power and oil sites, effective immediately.
beats.why: Both sides have been hitting energy targets, and a global diesel shortage, mainly from the Iran war, has pushed fuel prices up.

cards.body: On Monday the Kremlin said only that contacts are ongoing and it will comment later. It also rejected Zelenskyy's idea of a 60-day truce. Ukraine said overnight Russian strikes hit energy sites in several regions and killed at least 10 people.
cards.title: 🆕 Evening update

cards.body: Trump gave no details. Zelenskyy told Axios the ceasefire was news to him, and said Russian drones and a strike on a Kharkiv power plant continued on Sunday. He said Ukraine backs a truce and would stop hitting Russian refineries if Russia stops too. The Kremlin had not commented.

a.body: Both sides agreed and the energy ceasefire is in effect immediately.
a.label: Trump says

b.body: Ukraine was not informed. It supports a truce, but Russia must stop its attacks for it to work.
b.label: Zelenskyy says

cards.note: Trump made a similar claim in September, and both sides kept striking energy sites afterwards.

cards.body: India sent Kyiv and Moscow a three-part idea: stop attacks on ports and refineries, let grain, oil and gas leave Black Sea ports freely, and stop attacks on ships. Ukraine called it the most comprehensive plan it received. Five Indian sailors have died in Black Sea attacks.

cards.q: Can a partial 'energy only' ceasefire lead to real peace?

opts: Attacks on power plants, grids and refineries
cards.why: It is a partial truce: both sides stop hitting each other's energy sites, while the wider war goes on.
